newsitem.title: USA: Firstbank buying investment advisory firm.
newsitem.headline: Firstbank buying investment advisory firm.

text.p: Firstbank of Illinois Co said Thursday it signed a definitive agreement to acquire Zemenick & Walker Inc, an investment advisory firm based in St. Louis. Terms were not disclosed.
Zemenick & Walker serves high-net-worth individuals, municipalities and retirement plans in nine states and has assets under management of more than $300 million.

Firstbank said the transaction is expected to close in January. Zemenick & Walker will be a major part of Firstbank's newly formed asset management group which will provide fee-only investment-advisory services.
